title: 库存与物品管理繁琐低效
description: 库存系统复杂、物品查找困难，缺乏批量操作、搜索、标签等便捷功能，导致物品管理繁琐耗时。
evidence: la gestion de l'inventaire est compliqué et fait perdre beaucoup de temps
the shift click tends to move stuff to the wrong area in my inventory window

evidence_items.quote: Inventory. The bigger your ship the more frustating it becomes (like having multiple bins full of bags, cargo pants in those bags, just to store small items like spare parts and food).
evidence_items.description: 库存管理令人沮丧，船越大越明显，需要多个箱子装袋子等
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏。飞船越大就越令人抓狂（比如有多个装满袋子的箱子，袋子里还有工装裤，只是为了存放备件和食物之类的小物品）。

evidence_items.quote: 刚开始的几个小时储存空间给的很少，一个拖车基本上船里没空间了，补给站里背包也少刷
evidence_items.description: 开局储物空间很少，拖车占满船内空间，补给站背包刷新也少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 刚开始的几个小时储存空间给的很少，一个拖车基本上船里没空间了，补给站里背包也少刷

evidence_items.quote: the dwarf-fortress like is missing sorely needed features like a global inventory to allow the player to find that soldering iron with a charged battery somewhere in the ship
evidence_items.description: 缺少全局库存功能，玩家需手动翻找物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 矮人要塞式部分缺少了急需的功能，比如全局库存，让玩家能在飞船某处找到那把带有充电电池的烙铁

evidence_items.quote: Item sorting in kiosks for buying/selling is arcane
evidence_items.description: 买卖亭的物品分类排序难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 买卖亭中的物品分类方式神秘莫测

evidence_items.quote: you'd better have manually filled some backpacks with flooring cause otherwise your character will grab them 1 by 1 by 1.
evidence_items.description: 建造地板时角色逐个拾取物品，缺乏批量操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你最好手动往几个背包里装满地板，否则你的角色会一块一块一块地拿。

evidence_items.quote: the inventory management on the characters and the ship
evidence_items.description: 角色和飞船的库存管理存在问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色和飞船上的物品栏管理

evidence_items.quote: so I can simply haul what I uninstall without having to micro
evidence_items.description: 搬运已卸载物品需要繁琐的微操
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这样我就能直接把我拆下来的东西搬走，而不用去微操

evidence_items.quote: None of which you can shift click.
evidence_items.description: 库存管理无法使用 Shift 点击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这些你一个都不能按住Shift点击。

evidence_items.quote: Inventory management is headache-inducing
evidence_items.description: 物品栏管理令人头疼
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理让人头疼

evidence_items.quote: baffling design decisions about the clunky UI producing endless amounts of inventory tetris
evidence_items.description: 界面笨拙，导致无尽的物品栏整理问题。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 关于笨拙的UI产生无穷无尽的物品栏俄罗斯方块以及其他烦人问题的令人费解的设计决策

evidence_items.quote: since they have made changes to the inventory system I've given up on it. Finding smaller items, or specific items on the floor is too frustrating now.
evidence_items.description: 库存系统改动后，在地板上寻找小物品或特定物品变得非常令人沮丧
evidence_items.quote_zh: 自从他们对物品栏系统做出改动后，我就放弃它了。现在在地上找较小的物品或特定物品太令人沮丧了。

evidence_items.quote: the game doesn't even have a "Deposit/Stack similar items" button for containers
evidence_items.description: 缺少一键存入/堆叠同类物品的按钮
evidence_items.quote_zh: 都2026年了，游戏甚至没有为容器提供“存入/堆叠同类物品”按钮

evidence_items.quote: Why can't I pin my inventory to always be displayed?
evidence_items.description: 无法固定库存显示
evidence_items.quote_zh: 为什么我不能将我的物品栏固定为始终显示？

evidence_items.quote: the shift click tends to move stuff to the wrong area in my inventory window
evidence_items.description: Shift点击会把物品移到物品栏错误区域
evidence_items.quote_zh: Shift点击往往会把东西移到我的物品栏窗口中错误的位置

evidence_items.quote: Inventory micromangement is terrible
evidence_items.description: 库存管理繁琐，需要大量手动操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏的微观管理非常糟糕

evidence_items.quote: Cargo management becomes a punishing Tetris-like chore — boxes in boxes, micromanaging every tile.
evidence_items.description: 货物管理繁琐，像惩罚性的俄罗斯方块，浪费时间
evidence_items.quote_zh: 货物管理变成了一项像俄罗斯方块一样折磨人的苦差事——箱子里套箱子，事无巨细地管理每一格。

evidence_items.quote: Inventory management is tedious too, shift-clicking only moves items to the ground or into random inventory
evidence_items.description: 物品栏管理繁琐，shift点击只能移到地面或随机物品栏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理也很繁琐，按住Shift点击只会把物品移到地上或随机放进某个物品栏里

evidence_items.quote: the inventory UI overflows with containers if you're standing still and opening multiple containers, even if you don't have access to them.
evidence_items.description: 打开多个容器时库存界面溢出，即使无法访问容器也不会关闭，需要刷新界面
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你站着不动并打开多个容器，物品栏UI会被容器塞爆，即使你无权访问它们也是如此。

evidence_items.quote: the movement, inventory, and even the graphics are too rough and clunky for me
evidence_items.description: 库存界面粗糙笨重
evidence_items.quote_zh: 移动、物品栏，甚至画面对我来说都太粗糙、太笨重了

evidence_items.quote: The inventory is hard-coded positioned so that it covers the whole screen covering the interaction and view on the world around you.
evidence_items.description: 库存界面硬编码位置，覆盖整个屏幕，遮挡交互和视野
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏的位置是硬编码的，因此它会覆盖整个屏幕，遮住你与周围世界的互动和视野。

evidence_items.quote: they made a change to the inventory where you no longer have an inventory. only a couple slots, hand slots, belt,and bag, you have to drag large items, making the game incredibly tedious
evidence_items.description: 库存系统改为少量槽位，需要拖拽大型物品，操作繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们改动了库存系统，现在你不再拥有一个库存了。只有几个槽位，手部槽位、腰带和背包，你必须拖动大型物品，这让游戏变得极其繁琐

evidence_items.quote: Unable to label or change name of items
evidence_items.description: 无法给物品贴标签或改名，无法一眼看出容器里装了什么
evidence_items.quote_zh: 无法给物品贴标签或更改名称

evidence_items.quote: la gestion de l'inventaire est compliqué et fait perdre beaucoup de temps
evidence_items.description: 库存管理复杂，耗费大量时间
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理很复杂，浪费大量时间

evidence_items.quote: complex and claustrophobic inventory system, that has two batteries taking the same bulk space as a machete. Think it's cool that you can "Russian doll" items into backpacks, tool boxes, crates and bins? Try finding anything after you stopped playing for a weekend.
evidence_items.description: 库存系统复杂且令人感到幽闭，难以找到物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 复杂且幽闭的库存系统，两块电池占用的体积和一把砍刀一样大。觉得能把物品像"俄罗斯套娃"一样塞进背包、工具箱、板条箱和垃圾桶里很酷？等你停玩一个周末后再试试找任何东西。

evidence_items.quote: using the inventory is a bit clunky since opening it takes most of the screen making it hard to see anything when you want to both see stuff on the ground and see what's around you
evidence_items.description: 打开背包占用大部分屏幕，难以看到周围环境
evidence_items.quote_zh: 使用物品栏有点笨拙，因为打开它会占据大部分屏幕，当你想同时看到地上的东西和周围的环境时，就很难看清任何东西

evidence_items.quote: you accidentally click off one of the tiny inventory boxes you move
evidence_items.description: 移动物品时容易误点掉小库存格子
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你会不小心点掉你移动的某个微小物品栏格子

evidence_items.quote: WHY ON EARTH CAN'T I ROTATE ITEMS IN MY INVENTORY?!
evidence_items.description: 无法在物品栏中旋转物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我到底为什么不能在物品栏里旋转物品？！

evidence_items.quote: Les cases de l'inventaire sont minuscules
evidence_items.description: 物品栏格子非常小
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏的格子小得可怜

player_themes.title: 库存系统改为少量槽位，需要拖拽大型物品，操作繁琐

evidence_items.quote: they made a change to the inventory where you no longer have an inventory. only a couple slots, hand slots, belt,and bag, you have to drag large items, making the game incredibly tedious
evidence_items.description: 库存系统改为少量槽位，需要拖拽大型物品，操作繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们改动了库存系统，现在你不再拥有一个库存了。只有几个槽位，手部槽位、腰带和背包，你必须拖动大型物品，这让游戏变得极其繁琐

evidence_items.description: 物品栏管理繁琐，shift点击只能移到地面或随机物品栏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理也很繁琐，按住Shift点击只会把物品移到地上或随机放进某个物品栏里

evidence_items.description: Shift点击会把物品移到物品栏错误区域
evidence_items.quote_zh: Shift点击往往会把东西移到我的物品栏窗口中错误的位置
